}}'''Sarinde''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Chane Rocks]] [[Codarra]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sarinde}}

== Activities ==
She came from [[Red Springs Hold]] to help [[Indirian]] and says that the Wise Ones will fight the [[Shaido]] Wise Ones in battle.

When [[Aviendha]] asks for the Aiel to be included into the [[Dragon's Peace]], [[Rand]] is taken aback. Sarinde and the rest of the Wise Ones stand behind Aviendha, confirming that she speaks for the rest of her people. In the end the Aiel become the neutral enforcers of the Dragon's Peace, allowing them to cross nation to nation in the hunt of any criminal.

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
